data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The batch criticism mechanism fails to retire rival positions because coverage debt grows superlinearly (O(N^2)) with the number of accepted rivals, exhausting the criticism token budget. An optimization utilizing ensemble methods (directed research: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ensemble_learning) to weight and prioritize disanalogies would reduce coverage debt to near-linear growth and restore retirement dynamics.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the accepted rivals are highly redundant, the combinatorial explosion is illusory and simple linear coverage would suffice.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If ensemble criticism fails to satisfy the normative dependence-ref requirements of SRC_004, it may be rejected by the formal harness (SRC_007).","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the failure to retire rivals is due to a lack of ground truth rather than budget exhaustion, ensemble voting will not identify the correct rivals to retire.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Per SRC_001's budget-pressure causal loop, as accepted rivals grow from 18 to 60, the requirement to generate per-target warrants for every pair creates a combinatorial explosion of coverage debt. The criticism-weighted attention becomes saturated and fails to retire positions. By treating each criticism as a weak learner in an ensemble method that votes on the retirement of specific rivals, the limited attention budget is concentrated on the most vulnerable rivals, overcoming the coverage bottleneck.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
